observable_fact_sheet.business_goal_verbatim: Improve deadline adherence at fixed planned reviewer-hours.

observable_fact_sheet.note: These fields restate the public INPUT facts; infer diagnoses independently.

diagnosis.root_cause: The implementation satisfies the specified FIFO contract (R0) but fails to meet the business objective of improving deadline adherence. The synthetic comparison shows that while the current FIFO implementation misses 7 deadlines, an alternative due-date ordering approach only misses 1, indicating a misalignment between the implemented contract and the desired business outcome.
diagnosis.suggested_requirement_change: The requirement should be updated to prioritize deadline adherence over strict FIFO ordering when deadlines are critical. The new priority order would be: 1) meet deadline targets, 2) within that constraint, follow arrival_order as a tie-breaker.
diagnosis.remaining_uncertainty: The synthetic data does not validate real customer needs or regulatory requirements, so the business goal cannot be fully confirmed as validated.
